Title: Page language not set
Actual Result: No lang attribute; NVDA may read content with the wrong voice/pronunciation

Title: Page has no title
Actual Result: No <title>; screen reader announces file name/URL

Title: Logo image missing alt text
Actual Result: Screen reader reads image source / 'unlabeled graphic'

Title: Text inputs use placeholder as their only label
WCAG SC: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships; 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions
Found By: Custom PyTest check (axe did not flag)
Actual Result: Label text disappears on typing; no <label> associated with inputs
Fix Applied: Added visible <label for> elements; kept hints in aria-describedby

Title: County dropdown has no accessible name
Actual Result: NVDA announces 'combo box' with no name

Title: Duplicate id 'name' on two inputs
Actual Result: Label and aria references can point to the wrong field

Title: Insufficient color contrast
Actual Result: #b5b5b5 on white and white on #6fa8dc are below 4.5:1
Fix Applied: Notice text #4a4a4a; button #1f3a5f with white text

Title: Heading levels skip from h1 to h4
WCAG SC: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships; 2.4.6 Headings and Labels

Title: Visual heading is a styled <div>
Actual Result: Looks like a heading but is not in the heading list for screen reader users

Title: No landmarks or skip link
Actual Result: Keyboard users must tab through navigation on every page; no main/nav landmarks
Expected Result: Skip link as first Tab stop; <header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>
Fix Applied: Added skip link and landmark elements

Title: Focus indicator removed with outline:none
Actual Result: Keyboard users cannot see where focus is
Expected Result: Visible focus indicator on every interactive element

Title: Submit is a <div> with onclick
Actual Result: Cannot be reached or activated by keyboard; not announced as a button

Title: Icon-only button has no accessible name
Fix Applied: Replaced with text button 'Help with household size'

Title: Focusable button hidden with aria-hidden
Actual Result: Keyboard focus lands on an element screen readers cannot perceive
Fix Applied: Removed aria-hidden; converted to disclosure button with aria-expanded

Title: Ambiguous link text 'click here'
Found By: Custom PyTest check (axe did not flag)
Actual Result: Links list in NVDA (Insert+F7) shows 'click here' with no context

Title: Errors shown by red border only
Actual Result: Colorblind and screen reader users cannot tell which field failed
Expected Result: Text error per field, aria-invalid, linked with aria-describedby
Fix Applied: Added per-field error text, aria-invalid, error summary

Title: Error/confirmation messages not announced
Actual Result: Message changes silently; NVDA says nothing
Expected Result: Errors in role=alert summary (focused); success in role=status
Fix Applied: Error summary with role=alert; status region with role=status

Title: Data table has no header cells or caption
Actual Result: NVDA table navigation reads values without column context

Title: Viewport meta disables zoom
Expected Result: Users can zoom to at least 200%
